mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_decision_log (tenant_id, run_id, invocation_id, authz_decision, exec_decision, exec_status, ledger_status, reason_code, authz_version, closure_fingerprint, config_publish_seq, release_id, principal_id, tool_id, decision_kind, decision_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{invocationId}::uuid, #{authzDecision}, #{execDecision}, #{execStatus}, #{ledgerStatus}, #{reasonCode}, #{authzVersion}, #{closureFingerprint}, #{configPublishSeq}, #{releaseId}, #{principalId}, #{toolId}, #{decisionKind}, #{decisionAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_kind = 'INVOCATION') AS invocations, count(*) FILTER (WHERE authz_decision IN ('REJECT', 'DENY')) AS blockedByAuthz, count(*) FILTER (WHERE exec_decision = 'BLOCKED_QUOTA') AS blockedByQuota, count(*) FILTER (WHERE exec_status = 'RECONCILED') AS reconciled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE exec_status LIKE 'ERROR%') AS errors FROM cap_decision_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid

SELECT decision_id::text AS decisionId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, run_id::text AS runId, invocation_id::text AS invocationId, authz_decision AS authzDecision, exec_decision AS execDecision, exec_status AS execStatus, ledger_id AS ledgerId, decision_kind AS decisionKind, decision_at AS decisionAt FROM cap_decision_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid ORDER BY decision_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT decision_id::text AS decisionId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, run_id::text AS runId, invocation_id::text AS invocationId, authz_decision AS authzDecision, exec_decision AS execDecision, exec_status AS execStatus, ledger_id AS ledgerId, decision_kind AS decisionKind, decision_at AS decisionAt FROM cap_decision_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId}::uuid ORDER BY decision_at ASC

SELECT decision_id::text AS decisionId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, run_id::text AS runId, invocation_id::text AS invocationId, authz_decision AS authzDecision, exec_decision AS execDecision, exec_status AS execStatus, ledger_id AS ledgerId, decision_kind AS decisionKind, decision_at AS decisionAt FROM cap_decision_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid ORDER BY decision_at ASC
